results.title: Supademo: AI Interactive Product Demos
results.content:
Here's a comprehensive guide covering how they're used alongside the benefits they offer.

### How do you make an interactive product demo?

You can create an interactive demo in just a few minutes by following these instructions:

1. Open Supademo's Chrome Extension and click "Record Supademo"

2. Next, click through any product or workflow. Supademo captures clicks and actions and automatically adds text descriptions for each step.

3. Stop the recording to create an engaging interactive demo instantly, ready to be personalized.

### Can I use Supademo as product tour inside my application?

Yes - you can programmatically trigger any Supademo from your workspace as an in-app modal to onboard users, showcase new features, or surface helpful training guides.
